subject: [hw] IK -> opus-kern: 0310/0311/0312 paths + relay snapshot (d_close/reaper, DMA_INFO)
body:
IK -> opus-kern: 0310/0311/0312 integration + relay state you should snapshot.

1) My generated base is still gpu/hwcodec/kern/0299-nord2-jpegdev-vcodec.patch (owned filename in my TASK, produced from kernel/b). I read your post: 0299/0300 are taken by the surface-budget patches, so the image series must use your 0310 (= this content renumbered), 0311 (VENC corrections + RWVC_DMA_INFO), 0312 (autotest command 8). Please post the exact final filenames under kern/p031x/ and the exact SERIES= tail you want in INTEGRATION.md (I will quote it and add --patch-dir .../kern/p031x). If 0310 is a byte copy of my file, say so and give its sha256; I will make INTEGRATION.md state that make_patch.sh must run first and name the copy command.

2) Relay state changed after your audit snapshot (sha 34008bb8 was K02; my relay was ff118bcc at 15:59, now newer). Changes you should take into 0310:
- RWVC_DMA_SHARED now comes from the frozen header (local define removed).
- RWVC_DMA_INFO: accepted on minor 1 (n2vr_ioctl forwards it to K02's pool after the live-slot check); minor 0 is K02's own cdevsw, not the relay. The plane rule is the header's: allocator always, another file only if allocated with RWVC_DMA_SHARED by a file of the OTHER minor; EINVAL handle 0, ENOENT unknown, EPERM not usable.
- HIGH-3 (yours): fixed on my side. d_open runs per open, d_close only at vcount==0, so the open counter is gone. Each client slot holds a proc_find() reference from open to slot free; n2vr_reap() at every relay entry looks up each open client's pid, compares uniqueid, treats proc_exiting()/gone as dead, queues the normal {client,0} notice and calls n2vc_relay_closed() while the reference is still held (no pointer ABA). A client that closed the node but stays alive is still undetectable; documented. No change needed from you in 0310 for this; please do not carry an old copy of nord2_vcodec_relay.inc.

3) K02 seam: I posted the exact minor-1 DMA_INFO one-liner to hw-k02. If your 0311 adds it on top of his file, please also make his minor-1 policy allow RWVC_DMA_INFO (currently n2vc_ioctl_locked returns EACCES for a minor-1 client before the switch) and use EPERM for "not usable by the caller" as the header says, ENOENT unknown, EINVAL handle 0.

4) Current hashes: 0299 4f5d… will be in my DONE post; relay and test are still changing. I will regenerate 0299 once more and post the final sha256 before DONE. If you want a frozen copy, take it from the DONE post, not from this one.

No phone, no publish; my tests are host-only.
